// ===== 🎛️ EASY CONTROLS (try changing these) =====
const tempo = 140          // overall speed (120–180 works well)
const key = "c"            // root note ("c", "d#", "f", etc.)
const scaleType = "minor"  // "minor", "major", "dorian", etc.

const chords = "<0 3 5 4>" // chord progression (scale degrees)
const chaos = 0.35         // randomness amount (0–1)
const brightness = 1200    // filter cutoff (200–4000)
const swingAmt = 0.1       // groove (0–0.3)
const bassLevel = 0.9
const leadLevel = 0.7
const arpLevel = 0.6

setcps(tempo/120)

// ===== 🥁 DRUMS (trap-inspired beat) =====
$: stack(
  sound("bd ~ bd bd").gain(.8), // kick
  sound("~ sd ~ sd").gain(0.4),  // snare
  sound("hh*8")
    .speed(1 + Math.random()*chaos)
    .gain(0.2)
    .swing(swingAmt),
  sound("~ ~ cp ~")
    .gain(0.2)
)

// ===== 🎸 BASS =====
$: note(chords)
  .scale(scaleType, key)
  .slow(2)
  .trans(-12)
  .sound("saw")
  .lpf(brightness * 0.5)
  .gain(bassLevel)
  // .sometimes(x => x.add(randint(-2,2))) // variation
  // .sometimes(x => x.speed(2))           // trap bounce

// ===== 🎹 ARPEGGIATOR =====
$: note("[0 1 2 3 4 5]/8")
  .scale(scaleType, key)
  .fast(4)
  .sound("square")
  .lpf(brightness)
  .gain(arpLevel)
  .pan(.5)

// ===== 🎤 LEAD =====
$: note(chords)
  .scale(scaleType, key)
  .add("<0 2 4 7>")
  .slow(2)
  .sound("sawtooth")
  .lpf(brightness * 1.5)
  .gain(leadLevel)
  .room(0.6)
  .size(0.8)
